- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Plan #4493 said the new `job_durations` helper should GET the raw `/repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs` REST endpoint (snake_case `started_at`/`completed_at`, paginated) yet also "reuse the jobs-API plumbing in `failed_jobs_read`", which uses `gh run view --json jobs` (camelCase, returns all jobs in one read). The two instructions name different sources.
  **A**: Reused `failed_jobs_read` (`gh run view --json jobs`) for layer consistency — it returns all 20 matrix jobs without manual pagination. Verified the live payload uses camelCase `startedAt`/`completedAt` (read against a real run). Made `parse_job_durations_json` accept both camelCase and snake_case stamps so the parser also handles a raw `/jobs` payload, honouring both halves of the plan. `gh.py` resolves to `python/gh.py`; shard keys are 1-indexed (CI matrix `shard: [1..20]`), matching the existing `median_shard_totals` keys.
